title: Wide Sargasso Sea

vibeProfile.oneLine: The untold story of Jane Eyre's madwoman, in the lush colonial Caribbean.

summary: Jean Rhys reimagines the life of the 'madwoman in the attic' from Jane Eyre, giving voice to Antoinette, a Creole heiress in the lush, haunted Caribbean, and tracing how a marriage to a cold Englishman drives her toward the fate Bronte assigned her. Lyrical, feverish and steeped in the colonial history Bronte left offstage, it is a landmark of postcolonial and feminist fiction. A short, hypnotic novel that changes how you read its famous source forever.
whyReadIt: The 'madwoman in the attic' from Jane Eyre, finally given her own voice. Lyrical, feverish, and quietly devastating.

funFacts.text: Rhys spent decades on the book, reclaiming a character Charlotte Bronte had left silent.
